facts.function: grip logs (choker grapple) and ride the skyline cable to carry and pull slack for yarding logs (carriage)
facts.form: attachments/components of cable yarding log-handling systems, not complete machines

gri_path: Several different articles; classify the first-named (choker grapples); the carriages follow the same analysis

Section XVI note 2(b): the grapples and carriages are not goods of a specific chapter 84/85 heading and are suitable solely or principally for woodland log handling machinery (yarders/loaders) of heading 8428, so they go to heading 8431
GRI 6: 8431.3 parts of machinery of 8428 > 8431.39.00 other > 8431.39.00.70 of the woodland log handling equipment of 8428.90.0310

classification.rationale: Choker grapples and slack-pulling carriages are dedicated working components of cable yarding and log handling equipment, which is lifting and handling machinery of heading 8428. Under Section XVI note 2(b) they fall in heading 8431 as parts of 8428 machinery, and the statistical line 8431.39.00.70 specifically covers parts of woodland log handling equipment of 8428.90.0310. H81340 classified a grapple hanger for log loaders as parts of 8428 machinery in 8431.39.
